requirements.name: three connected furnished rooms
requirements.observed: Native movement visited hall, corridor and vault. Actual screenshots show walls, floors, pictures, plants, table/vase and bookshelves/safe; original blank map also remains unused.

requirements.name: visible native five-petal health
requirements.observed: Blue flower is a real inventory item and var_petals is real; HUD still shows five cream hearts and 514/514 at variable values 5,4,3,1 and0. No native petals are present.
requirements.staticCapability: set_life_flower exists and was not called; lack of use is not a missing tool.

requirements.name: damage/heal and zero-health defeat
requirements.observed: Native picture investigation changes 5→4; vase changes4→5; subsequent hits and actual saved-state Continue reach3→2→1→0. At0 a real bad ending, credits and THE END overlay appear; attempted movement under final overlay does not move.

requirements.name: actual four-digit input puzzle
requirements.observed: Safe uses four restricted choices menus, not inputNumber or native digit typing.
requirements.staticCapability: compile_puzzle password already supports numeric input; model did not use it.

requirements.name: clue-accessible answer without answer menu
requirements.observed: All four clue texts were actually read across three rooms and yield7294. Digit menus include correct digit at every step (1/3/7/9 etc). No whole7294 answer is labelled correct, but restricted digit menus violate direct input/no answer-menu request.

requirements.name: key-gated escape ending
requirements.observed: Without key the action is handled but does not escape (silent false branch). Correct native choices create item_gallery_key1. Solved-safe reinspection leaves count1. With key the exit produces actual success epilogue/credits.

requirements.name: saved project and save resume
requirements.observed: Actual editor UI save succeeds in attempt2, but fresh context changes full stored SHA/revision by promoting four generated assets. Final attempt3 repeats unchanged revision28 and strict SHA equality. Native player manual Save routes to items, yet transfer autosave stores partial health3 and fresh-tab Continue restores3/flower1; after defeat Continue also restores the checkpoint3.
requirements.inference: Composite failure is strict first content-save reload mismatch and broken manual saving; automatic Continue is independently passed.

adversarial.name: escape without key

adversarial.staticCapability: Manual Save UI remains failed; this pass covers actual product autosave/Continue.

adversarial.name: loss/death/retry
adversarial.observed: Bad ending reaches final THE END; movement attempt leaves(5,3) at0. Fresh-player native Continue restores last autosave3 in corridor, rather than defeated unsaved0.

adversarial.observed: Inner cancel is verified defective; independent outer cancel and post-solved map-reentry stale-password bypass were not executed. Do not infer these pass from static event pages.
